act.name: Environment (Protection) Act, 1986
act.source_authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India
act.description: Umbrella central law empowering environmental protection measures, standards, directions, accident safeguards and penalties.

sections.title: Power to give directions.
sections.text: Section 5 empowers the Central Government to issue written environmental directions, including closure or regulation and stoppage of services.
sections.plain_language_summary: The Central Government may issue binding written directions, including closure or regulation of an industry and stoppage or regulation of electricity, water or other services.

sections.title: Penalty for contravention of the provisions of the Act and the rules, orders and directions.
sections.text: Section 15 establishes penalties for contravening the Act or its rules, orders and directions.
sections.plain_language_summary: Contravention of environmental statutory requirements, rules, orders or directions attracts the penalties prescribed by this section.
